text: Teaching Objective The Doctor’s Degree of Management Science and Engineering for foreign students is to train high-lever specialized personnel in engaging in management science research and practice. Educational Requirements 1. Good moral qualities and the spirit of devoting, cooperating, developing and innovating; 2. A good command of basic theories and systematic professional knowledge, and understanding of the frontier trends in the profession; 3. The ability of doing management scientific research independently, and the ability of applying professional knowledge to analyze and solve practical problems; 4. the ability of doing statistics analysis, case study, countermeasure analysis and applying qualitative analysis and quantitative analysis; 5. At least one creative research fruit in management science and engineering field; 6. A fairly good grasp of computer. Major Course Optimization Theory and Method Advanced Mathematics Model International Marketing Management Modern Enterprise Institution Advanced Organizational Development Enterprise Risk Mangement Multinational Company Financial Risk Management and Performance Evaluation Operations Management Management Science Management Research Methods Product Innovation Management Strategic Management of Technology and Innovation Duration 3 academic years
